replies.body:
Howdy there, apparently these shitter admins decided to let ya'll sr mods vote on this because they're confident that ya'll will just agree with whatever they say and to shift the blame from them to you. Here's the run down because I don't trust them to tell the story so I'll do it.

I was removed from TS Dev because the rank was removed (as a bullshit way of removing my control over TS and readying me for a month long ban to which I received no legitimate responses to my numerous appeals) as all of you know, however my retired rank was for me formerly having the mod rank. They removed my mod rank because of "Overall Immaturity". When I asked for specific examples they said my forums behavior. The problem is however is that I don't have any infractions for the last 8 months. That means that the removal of my retired rank was due to something that wasn't against the rules and since there is no policy for the retired rank it also wasn't against any policies. That means that this demotion was a load of crap cooked up by certain senior staff in an effort to abuse me and my associates at every turn due to their personal disdain for us. My rank was removed because I disagree with the admins not due to any actions that violated any rules.
